faq.q: What marbella birthday yacht decorations themes are most popular?
faq.a: Balloon arches in gold, rose gold, or white are the top choice for birthday yacht parties in Marbella. Custom banners with the guest of honour's name, flower garlands along the rails, and LED letter signs are also very popular. For sunset cruises, fairy lights and floral hoops create a magical atmosphere. Avoid confetti cannons or glitter as they can damage the upholstery.

faq.q: Can I bring my own decorations on board?
faq.a: Yes, you can bring your own decorations, but please avoid anything that leaves residue or could damage the boat. Balloons, banners, flower arrangements, and LED lights are all fine. We recommend using biodegradable confetti if you must have it, but it's best to skip it entirely. Your skipper can advise on placement during the pre-departure briefing.

faq.q: How long does decoration setup take before the charter?
faq.a: Setup typically takes 30 to 60 minutes, depending on the complexity. If you're using a professional decorator, they should coordinate with our team to access the boat at least 1 hour before departure. For simpler setups like a banner and a few balloons, 30 minutes is enough. We suggest arriving 15 minutes early to oversee the final look.

faq.q: Which yachts are best for a birthday party with decorations?
faq.a: For a group of up to 12 guests, the Mangusta 80 (24m) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) offer plenty of deck space for decorations and socialising. The Ferretti 94 (29m) is ideal for larger setups with its spacious flybridge and saloon. For smaller parties (5–8 guests), the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 work well and are budget-friendly.

faq.q: Are there any restrictions on decorations for safety reasons?
faq.a: Yes, decorations must not obstruct walkways, exits, or the skipper's view. Balloons should be secured to rails or furniture, not left loose. No open flames (candles) are allowed, but battery-operated LED candles are fine. Heavy items like large flower arrangements must be placed on tables or counters, not on the floor where they could become trip hazards.

faq.q: How much does a birthday yacht charter with decorations cost in Marbella?
faq.a: A 2-hour charter on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 starts at €749 (all inclusive). For an 8-hour full-day trip, it's €2,299. The Mangusta 80 starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. Decoration costs are separate — expect to pay €100–€500 depending on the theme and complexity. Contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote.

We also offer a premium catering upgrade (pricing on request) that includes tapas, paella, or sushi platters. Just let us know at least 48 hours in advance so we can coordinate with the skipper and ensure proper storage.

Midday trips (12:00–14:00) are great for sunbathing and swimming stops. Evening charters (20:00–22:00) allow for dinner under the stars. data.body_html:
Celebrating a birthday on the water in Marbella is an unforgettable experience, and the right decorations can transform a luxury yacht into a personalised party venue. Whether you're planning a surprise for a loved one or treating yourself, choosing the perfect marbella birthday yacht decorations themes is key. From balloon arches to custom banners, this guide covers everything you need to know about setup ideas, costs, and practical tips for your celebration. All our charters depart from Puerto Banús, and we offer boats for 5 to 12 guests.

Why choose a birthday yacht party in Marbella?

Marbella's coastline offers calm Mediterranean waters, stunning views of La Concha mountain, and exclusive marinas like Puerto Banús. A yacht charter gives you privacy, flexibility, and a unique backdrop for photos. You can swim at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, enjoy a sunset cruise past the Golden Mile, or anchor near Cabopino for a quiet spot. With a dedicated skipper, you don't have to worry about navigation or safety — just focus on the fun.

Popular decoration themes for birthday yachts

Balloon arches in gold, rose gold, or white are the top choice for birthday yacht parties in Marbella. Custom banners with the guest of honour's name, flower garlands along the rails, and LED letter signs are also very popular. For sunset cruises, fairy lights and floral hoops create a magical atmosphere. Avoid confetti cannons or glitter as they can damage the upholstery. Many clients also opt for a colour scheme that matches the yacht's interior — neutral tones work well on white leather, while bright colours pop on darker wood finishes.

Which yachts work best for decorations?

Our fleet includes several vessels with ample space for decorations. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) has a large flybridge and aft deck perfect for a balloon arch. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 guests) offers a spacious saloon and outdoor seating. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 guests) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 guests) are budget-friendly options starting at €749 for 2 hours. All depart from Puerto Banús, so decorations can be set up at the dock before departure.

Setup ideas and practical tips

Setup typically takes 30 to 60 minutes, depending on complexity. Balloons should be secured to rails or furniture, not left loose. No open flames (candles) are allowed, but battery-operated LED candles are fine. Heavy items like large flower arrangements must be placed on tables or counters. Your skipper can advise on placement during the pre-departure briefing. We recommend arriving 15 minutes early to oversee the final look.

Costs: charter prices and decoration budgets

Charter prices are all-inclusive (skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, IVA). Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours up to €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) start at €4,719 for 4 hours and include a free jet ski. Other boats like the Ferretti 94 or Canados 86 are priced on request via WhatsApp. Decoration costs are separate — expect to pay €100–€500 depending on the theme and complexity. Many local decorators in Marbella deliver to Puerto Banús.

Catering and cake arrangements

You can bring your own birthday cake and catering on board. Many local bakeries in Marbella deliver to Puerto Banús. We also offer a premium catering upgrade (pricing on request) that includes tapas, paella, or sushi platters. Just let us know at least 48 hours in advance so we can coordinate with the skipper and ensure proper storage. All standard charters include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks.

Best time of day for a birthday charter

Sunset charters (18:00–20:00 in summer) are the most popular, offering golden light for photos and a cooler atmosphere. Midday trips (12:00–14:00) are great for sunbathing and swimming stops. Evening charters (20:00–22:00) allow for dinner under the stars. All depart from Puerto Banús, with views of La Concha mountain. For a full-day experience, an 8-hour charter lets you visit Estepona or Sotogrande.
